receipts.title: Written-duration command deletes neighbouring occurrences
receipts.detail: Lengthened ev-treble-1-1080-0-bp-1 from 600 to 1560 ticks (+960 ticks = a half note = two quarter-note beats at ppq 480). 1 linked occurrence(s) of ev-treble-1-1680-2-bp-4 disappeared: performance 1338 -> 1334.

receipts.title: Event move rewrites every chord member to one tempo-derived onset
receipts.detail: Moved ev-treble-1-2160-3-bp-5 (2 notes) by one sixteenth. Distinct recorded onsets before: 2; after: 1. Every member is re-stamped from ticks x tempo, so exact seconds are replaced.

receipts.title: A 10 ms recorded-onset nudge with Snap off is rounded away
receipts.detail: Requested 0.9272 s; the editor can only pass 1080 ticks, so 0.9310 s was stored. Net change 0.0138 s.

receipts.title: Tie deletes the second attack and rewrites the recorded length
receipts.detail: Tied ev-treble-1-3360-6-bp-10: recorded length 0.9404 s -> 1.0344827586206897 s (tempo-derived), 1 absorbed occurrence(s) removed, and untie did not restore them.

receipts.title: Insert silently replaces the note it lands on
receipts.detail: Inserting at 1080 ticks removed bp-1 (0.917 s) with no error or warning; total occurrences unchanged (1338 -> 1338).

receipts.title: Same-pitch, same-onset occurrences lose their mapping at build time
receipts.detail: Two occurrences at the same pitch and onset produce one logical note linked only to "dup-a". The other stays in performance (2) but is unmapped (1 unmapped), so it is unselectable and uneditable.

receipts.title: A third overlapping voice is merged or truncates the previous event
receipts.detail: Three same-onset groups produce 2 event(s); 1 event(s) were shortened below a quarter note without any report. The third voice is merged into a chord or absorbed by truncating the previous event.

receipts.title: No-op commands return a new document
receipts.detail: respellAccidental(natural) returned a new object: true; changeStaff(same) returned a new object: true. changePitch(same) returns the original identity: true.

receipts.title: Every command rebuilds all segments, ties and generated rests
receipts.detail: Ten sequential pitch edits took 358 ms (36 ms each). Each edit regenerates 2335 segments, 740 ties and 592 generated rests. Serialised document size 1.50 MB (serialised-size estimate, not a measured heap).

receipts.title: A logical note with several occurrences is edited as a whole
receipts.detail: One logical note linked to two occurrences (1.0 s and 3.0 s). A single changePitch(n-m-a, 61) changed both: m-a, m-b. There is no split or rejection path in the command.

receipts.title: Delete one chord member leaves the rest intact
receipts.detail: Deleting pitch 61 from ev-treble-1-2160-3-bp-5 kept pitch 80 at its recorded length 0.3264 s.

receipts.title: Pitch change on one chord member leaves the rest intact
receipts.detail: Changing 61 kept neighbour 80 at 80 with onset 1.8692 s and length 0.3264 s.

receipts.title: Selecting a generated rest then Delete inserts an explicit rest
receipts.detail: Generated rests carry no event id, so the destructive delete branch is unreachable; the editor instead falls through to insertRest (NotationEditor deleteSelection). Not executed because it is a React handler, not a package command.

receipts.title: Reviewed editor ignores the sync offset
receipts.detail: MusicLessonEditor passes only a video URL to NotationEditor; the roll draws raw performance onsets while the playhead is video time. Measuring it needs a reviewed revision with a non-zero offset, which the local database does not contain.
